thread:
alice.h: FYI — noticed a spike of premerge SAST failures on the main branch around the keystore rotation last night. CI logs show KMS Decrypt: AccessDenied.
ben.s: Oof. Which job exactly? staging-sast-run? Link?
alice.h: staging-sast-run and prod-like e2e lint that needs secrets to decrypt test fixtures. Example error: `googleapi: Error 403: Permission denied for serviceAccount:ci-build-sa@...`
devon.k: That’s our ephemeral KMS key rotation hitting the CI service account. We rotate keys every 24h and rely on short-lived grants; looks like the grant refresh failed for this run.
security-bot: Created ticket SDLC-9284: "CI KMS grant refresh failure causing premerge SAST block" and assigned to @devon.k
devon.k: I dug in — token refresh loop met a transient IAM error when requesting `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for the build SA. IAM responded with 5xx then LB retried and grant not applied before job started.
alice.h: Immediate ask: can we relax the premerge gate to not block merges for this class of Decrypt errors while we patch? Risk vs speed tradeoff.
ben.s: Prefer not to relax gate broadly. Suggest two options: 1) Add a conditional allow for CI that grants Decrypt during PR builds (short window), 2) Add a quick retry in the runner to wait for grant confirmation.
devon.k: Proposed quick patch: On PR start, pipeline runs `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding ci-build-sa --member=serviceAccount:pipeline@... --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition="title=ephemeral,expr=request.time < timestamp_add(request.time, duration('600s'))"` then verify with `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` before decrypt step. Fallback: if Decrypt denied, retry 3x with exponential backoff.
oncall_rotations: If we add ephemeral grants we need audit hooks. Audit log must show grant create/delete and owner. Also add PagerDuty alert if Decrypt fails >3 times for >15m.
alice.h: Agree on audit + PD. Also need a short postmortem template pinned to ticket: timeline, root cause (IAM 5xx during grant), mitigations, and follow-up to harden grant refresh.
ben.s: Can we add a guard in the keystore rotation operator to retry IAM calls with jitter and increase max attempts from 3 to 8? That should reduce transient failures.
devon.k: Yep. I'll prepare a small change to the operator and a PR for the pipeline retry loop. Plan: patch in staging tomorrow AM, monitor for 48h, then roll to prod. Keeping premerge gate unchanged for now.
alice.h: Who signs off on the ephemeral grant flow? Need security review and an auditor listed in the rollout note.
ben.s: @alice.h + @devon.k to submit to security review board. I'll add @oncall_rotations as the emergency contact in the rollout notes.
ci-bot: CI: PR 4821 — pipeline update for keystore-rotation-retries — tests green (staging).
security-bot: Added audit checklist to SDLC-9284: include policy snippet, key id, TTL, and deletion plan.
alice.h: Cool. Action items: devon prepare PR, ben to add operator retry policy, devon to add pipeline verification step, ben to draft PD alert runbook. Target: deploy staging patch by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll update the ticket and ping oncall if anything blocks.
devon.k: On it. I'll also include the policy snippet we used for testing:
```
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  member: serviceAccount:ci-build-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  condition:
    title: ephemeral-ci-grant
    expression: request.time < timestamp("2026-03-22T09:10:00Z")
```
alice.h: Thanks. If anyone sees more failures overnight please @mention me and escalate to PD. :eyes:
ben.s: Thx — will follow up after staging run
